To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new type of reverted austenite is formed in upper bainitic steel through two phase region heat treatment, and this new type of structure is beneficial for improving toughness at low temperature and refining the effective grain.

a new type of reverted austenite is found to form in the upper bainite with slow cooling after two phase heat treatment and that this new type of reversed austenite is helpful to increase low temperature impact toughness and slightly decrease yield strength.

the new type of reverted structures can be generated in upper bainitic steel by annealing at temperature between A1 (or M3) and A3 (or M3), and that the formation of this new type of structures can improve low temperature impact toughness of upper bainitic steels by increasing the density of boundaries above 45deg.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the crystallographically related microstructure and properties in low carbon bainite steel.
the formation of reverted structure and the effect of reverted structure and reverted packet on the properties of upper bainite low carbon steel.

a new type of reverted structures which can be used to improve low temperature impact toughness of low carbon steel and the effect of this structure on the yield strength and low temperature toughness is discussed in detail.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new reverted structure is a new type of reverted austenite and its formation is helpful for the improvement of low temperature impact toughness.
the new type of reverted structures formed through annealing in the two phase region heat treatment could be beneficial to the toughness improvement of upper bainite steels.

this new type of "reverted packet", formed by reverted structure and its parallel matrix, could effectively increase the density of high-angle boundaries and hence inhibit the propagation of micro-cracks and decrease the DBTT, but not significantly increase the yield strength.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this new type of "reverted structure" can be considered as an effective way to improve toughness of low temperature brittle fracture by increasing the density of effective boundaries and refining the effective grain sizes in addition to the conventional way to improve toughness by increasing retained austenite.
the reverted structure could effectively improve low temperature impact toughness by increasing the density of effective high angle boundaries.
the new type of reverted structures could be considered as an alternative to improve toughness in low carbon steels.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, by generating this new structure through annealing at two phase region heat treatment, it is possible to improve low temperature impact toughness of bainitic steel without sacrificing the yield strength level.

, in addition to the well-known "reverted grain" which is formed by the reverted transformation in the two phase region heat treatment, there also exists another type of reverted structure which can be called as "reverted structure" in the bainitic matrix.
, in addition to increasing retained austenite content, the crystallographic structure of reverted structure is also an important factor to improve the impact toughness.
